scope: Portable single-cell draft runtime, relevant existing helpers/tests, and specs/grid-editing.md only. Native adapter and independent consumer are not certified by this record.

resolved.title: Clipped overscan BeginEdit admission
resolved.correction: Current bounded row geometry and cell clip checked before beginning.

resolved.title: Per-cell version reuse/rollback after admitted conflict or permission change
resolved.correction: Prospective lastValue validates monotonic version and same-version exact text/editability; retained across missing rows and changed current incarnation; published only with accepted source.

checked_invariants: Single publication of candidate source and draft removal after geometry/capacity/selection and late edited-cell/source checks.
Prepared exact source stamp rejects outdated proposals after source admission; fresh proposal retains unrelated current-domain edits; viewport-only changes preserve proposal.
Session identity plus local draft revision rejects cancel/restart and draft ABA; generation/session/draft exhaustion refuses atomically.
Recoverable draft read/set/cancel remains usable after unacknowledged source drift; Prepare/Complete require current live source.
Private token has no Grid/source backpointer; accepted baseline/current/draft/lastValue/request strings detach large caller backing allocations.
Length guard precedes UTF8 scanning for bounded edit input; positive cell versions and exact Cell/EditCell agreement checked.
All-row scans absent from new edit flow; source reads are indexed and bounded; captured requests are caller-owned retained values.
limits: Provider metadata/index/value methods must obey documented owner confinement, immutability/nonblocking and no reentry; this does not certify hidden cells or arbitrary provider side effects.

MaxEditBytes bounds each retained edit string, not all caller snapshots or total memory. MaxTextBytes remains a separate Snapshot payload admission bound; source admission does not promise every future Snapshot will succeed.
No native text/IME, external AX, physical input, GUI, performance, Git or Prism execution in this qualification.
Parent root separately qualifies the full portable/UI suite and will qualify native/consumer paths.
